localReader.scope: Private local reading only; public publication, licences, attribution review and embedding state are unchanged

localReaderAudit.scope: All canonical works/editions/assets and all intake files; reading shelves cover the existing 52 profiles. Source databases, files, rights and embeddings unchanged. Unlinked files are not assigned by guesswork.

counting: Contributors are source identities, organizations and unresolved credits, not a verified count of unique people. Works count canonical work IDs only. Groups without work IDs are separate record representations, never deduplicated by title. Public, local reader and intake records can represent the same file; counts do not sum to distinct books. Unattributed records are separate from people. Local reading is restricted to the existing loopback reader.
